# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT_WITH_VIX_GATE

**Filed:** 2026-06-29
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that a trendline breakout with a VIX gate can capture the edge of a volatility-driven move. The VIX gate will filter out low-volatility days, reducing the likelihood of false breakouts.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves identifying a trendline breakout on the 5-minute chart and checking if the VIX is above a certain threshold (e.g., 18). If both conditions are met, the engine will enter a trade with a predefined contract selection and stop-loss strategy.
